title: CODATA 2022: Compton wavelength and classical electron radius
summary: Compton wavelength 2.426 310 235 38 × 10⁻¹² m. Classical electron radius 2.817 940 3205 × 10⁻¹⁵ m. Both have printed uncertainties.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'Compton wavelength 2.426 310 235 38 e-12' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 76 e-12', in metres. It prints 'classical electron radius 2.817 940 3205 e-15' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0013 e-15', in metres. Both are derived quantities in the adjustment. Neither is marked exact.
